features.fields: OSM-sourced features only: id, category, tags, geographicGeometry (else geometry); nativeSectors for buildings; authoredStructures ids and geometry

policy: Public-domain USGS 3DEP lidar. Heights are metres above the ground ring around each outline; elevations are NAVD88 metres. Nothing here edits the generator, sectors or art kit.

registration.method: Share of 0.5 m footprint cells over class-6 returns at every whole-cell shift within ±4 m, peak placed by a parabola through its neighbours; per 240 m sector with 10+ buildings for the spread.

method.roofPoints: class 6 (building) returns inside the registered outline; unclassified last returns 1.5 m+ above ground added where class 6 covers under 30% of it
method.ground: median of class-2 (ground) returns within 4 m outside the outline; the bare-earth grid where fewer than 10
method.eave: area-weighted median of the roof planes' low edges (5th-percentile cells): where the roof over most of the outline meets the walls; a flat roof's deck; the quartile height where no plane was found
method.upperEave: where a taller roof stands at least 1.5 m above that eave: the low edge of the substantial planes (10%+ of plane area) topping out within 1 m of the highest, and their share of the plane area (null otherwise)
method.planes: up to six largest planes: [area m², slope °, downslope bearing °, fit rms m, low edge m, top m]; heights above the ground
method.percentiles: heightM holds percentiles of every roof return above the ground

preRegistered.note: The measure fixed before the first run. It failed the gate: porch, carport and wing roofs inside an outline put its low percentile at their eaves, so two-storey houses read as one. The plane-based eave replaced it; thresholds and gate are unchanged.
